csv_project_name: Acquisition and Development for 2026 Affordable Housing
csv_agency: Mason Public Health and Human Services
csv_scope_of_work: 2026 Affordable Housing Acquisition, Development, Preservation. Mason Public Health and Human Services is soliciting proposals from qualified nonprofit or eligible organizations to expand, construct, and preserve the affordable housing stock in Mason County. This Request for Proposals (RFP) is part of the Real Property Rapid Acquisition, New Permanent Supportive Housing, and Affordable Housing Preservation, which supports efforts to end homelessness and expand access to safe, stable, and healthy housing for extremely low and very low-income individuals and families.
title: Acquisition and Development for 2026 Affordable Housing
short_description: RFP for affordable housing acquisition, development, and preservation in Mason County.
project_scope: Acquisition, development, expansion, construction, and preservation of affordable housing stock in Mason County under a program for rapid real property acquisition, new permanent supportive housing, and affordable housing preservation for extremely low and very low-income individuals and families. No gross floor area, unit count, or technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services for affordable housing acquisition, development, construction, expansion, and preservation.
relevance_explanation:
- Housing development project with no stated structural complexity or special long-span features.
- Primarily a developer/design-build procurement rather than a clearly defined structural engineering assignment.
- Could involve building design, but the notice provides no information on size, complexity, or architecturally demanding scope.
- Affordable housing is generally less aligned with sbp's core focus than bridges, roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Useful missing inputs for an estimate include number of housing units, total floor area, building type, acquisition share versus new construction, preservation scope, and site conditions. Without these, no realistic cost estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Since scope, size, and procurement structure are undefined and this is a developer/design-build solicitation, no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Proposals are requested from qualified nonprofit or eligible organizations. Specific reference project requirements or technical qualification criteria are not stated in the notice excerpt.
contracting_authority: Mason Public Health and Human Services, Shelton, WA, USA. Contact: Todd Parker. Phone: 360-427-9670. Email: tparker@masoncountywa.gov. Website: https://masoncountywa.gov/services/bids.php
notes: Project #: 870270. AgencyID: 90798. ProjectID: 1016817. DR #: 202600277024. County: Mason. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Solicitation documents available online. The notice describes a programmatic housing procurement rather than a specifically defined single building project.
